create_vector_features_wrapper: create a VectorFeaturesWrapper to normalize NetHack blstats into network-friendly vector observations clipped to [-5, 5]
render_char_images_wrapper: create a RenderCharImagesWithNumpyWrapper to render NetHack terminal characters as RGB images using cached PIL glyphs
initialize_char_array: call initialize_char_array to pre-render all 256 printable characters in 16 colors into a cached NumPy array
tile_characters_to_image: use tile_characters_to_image to composite cached character tiles into an output image with optional viewport offsets
create_message_wrapper: create a MessageWrapper to track and count repeated NetHack messages for LLM-based reward shaping
